name: Peasants
description: Just some dudes with sticks. Never dilutes or benefits from the infantry/ranged/cavalry counter triangle — wins or loses on raw stats alone.

name: Infantry
description: Basic foot soldiers forming the backbone of every army. Recruited from the draft pool generated by Barracks — no direct money cost. Strong against Cavalry, weak against Ranged.

name: Archers
description: Ranged skirmishers who weaken enemy formations before contact. High offensive value but fragile in direct combat. Strong against Infantry, weak against Cavalry.

name: Pikemen
description: Heavy infantry armed with long pikes. Exceptional at holding defensive lines and punishing cavalry charges. Counts as Infantry — strong against Cavalry, weak against Ranged.

name: Knights
description: Elite heavy cavalry clad in full plate. Devastating in open battle but costly to equip and maintain. Requires an Armory. Strong against Ranged, weak against Infantry/Pikemen.

name: Noble Knights
description: NOBLE-only. The finest cavalry in the realm. Requires a Fort. SPECIAL category — never dilutes or benefits from the counter triangle.

name: Paladins
description: HOLY-only. Warriors of God, recruited and maintained on piety rather than money. Requires a Temple. SPECIAL category — never dilutes or benefits from the counter triangle.

name: Mercenaries
description: GUILD-only. Soldiers of fortune, hired directly with money rather than drawn from the draft pool. Requires a Trade House. SPECIAL category — never dilutes or benefits from the counter triangle.

name: Grand Host
description: NOBLE elite capstone. A mounted host fielded on the noble class's own Warhorses, but permanently fed on Relics — HOLY's prestige good. Lose your trade route to a Holy neighbor and this army starves. Requires a Stud Farm.

name: Templar Order
description: HOLY elite capstone. Sworn knights recruited on piety and the holy class's own Relics, but permanently fed on Spices — GUILD's prestige good. Lose your trade route to a Guild neighbor and this army starves. Requires a Reliquary.

name: Free Company
description: GUILD elite capstone. Hired outright with money and the guild class's own Spices, bypassing the draft pool entirely — but permanently fed on Warhorses, NOBLE's prestige good. Lose your trade route to a Noble neighbor and this army starves. Requires a Spice Wharf.
